name: Paris IdFM Trains Pack
author: Haeffound
description:
This pack contains various Paris-region rolling-stock. ## MÉTRO
Vehicle Description Top Speed (km/h) Passenger Capacity (per car) Carriage Number
MF 01 A modern steel-wheel metro designed for Paris’s historic lines. Comfortable and efficient, it features full-width gangways and refrigerated ventilation. 70 158 5
MF 19 The latest generation of steel-wheel metro designed to replace several ageing Paris Metro fleets. Modular in length and energy-efficient, with regenerative braking. Available in 4- and 5-car configurations. 70 161 4/5
MP 89 Rubber-tyred metro train available in both automatic and manually driven versions. Its strong acceleration makes it well suited to dense urban routes with closely spaced stations. Available in 5- and 6-car configurations. 80 158 5/6
MP 14 The latest generation of rubber-tyred metro trains in Paris, available in several train lengths and both automated and driver-operated versions. Available in 5-, 6- and 8-car configurations. 80 160 5/6/8
MR3V / MR6V An automated steel-wheeled metro for the new Grand Paris Express lines 15, 16 and 17, built to modern standards. Available in 3- and 6-car configurations. 110 200 3/6
## RER & TRANSILIEN
Vehicle Description Top Speed (km/h) Passenger Capacity (per car) Carriage Number
MI 09 A double-deck electric multiple unit designed for high passenger volumes. It combines high capacity, strong acceleration and numerous doors for rapid passenger exchange on Line A. 120 345 5/10
MI 84 A dual-voltage electric multiple unit designed to operate across both the RATP and SNCF networks on Line B. 120 212 4/8
MI 20 The planned replacement for the MI 84, designed to increase capacity and accessibility on RER B, with a second floor on half of the cars. 120 152 7/14
Z 2N A family of double-deck electric multiple units developed over several generations. Robust, spacious and fast, it is suited to longer distances between stations. Available in 4- and 5-car configurations. 140 400 4/5/8/10
RER NG A new-generation double-deck electric multiple unit combining high capacity and strong acceleration for intensive urban and suburban operations. Available in 6- and 7-car configurations. 140 260 6/7/12/14
Francilien (NAT) A modern suburban electric multiple unit recognizable by its unusually wide body and spacious interior. Designed for frequent-stop Transilien services and longer suburban sections. Its one door per car can increase dwell times. Available in 7- and 8-car configurations. 140 132 7/8/14/16
## TRAM, TRAM-TRAIN & VAL
Vehicle Description Top Speed (km/h) Passenger Capacity (per car) Carriage Number
Dualis A versatile tram-train designed to operate on both conventional railway and tramway sections. Its fully low-floor design, ability to handle steep gradients and higher speed suit mixed urban and suburban routes. 100 64 4/6
Citadis X05 A modern tram designed for intensive urban operation. Numerous doors and a low-floor layout prioritize accessibility and rapid passenger exchange. Available in different lengths for higher-capacity corridors. 70 45 5/6/7
VAL 206 / 208 A compact, fully automated rubber-tyred transit system combining high frequency, strong acceleration and flexible alignment for dedicated urban and airport links. 80 100 2/4
This use the new feature of the game to allow so rolling stock to ride others rails (exemple, all MF can share tracks). This feature has a limitation currently; I recommend using Francilien station on all RER/Francilien network because it allow the greater number of carriage. Warning,
